description: Multi-turn conversations. Deterministic metrics from what the director did: rule violations, whether everyone spoke on a new topic, how evenly the speaking was spread, and messages per turn. The first message of each conversation is a new topic; later ones marked new_topic are too.

turns.message: My manager keeps giving me work on weekends. Should I say something or just put up with it?
He's actually nice otherwise. I don't want to ruin it.
Totally different thing: should I get a cat or a dog?
Hi everyone! ChaiCart runs 12 electric chai carts outside Pune metro stations, selling 4,000 cups a day at ₹20. We're asking ₹25 lakh for 10%.
Margins are 45% per cup and each cart pays back in 7 months.
We'd use the money for 28 more carts and an office delivery subscription.
Wait, so what does backpropagation actually do?
I got the offer. Part of me wants to go, part of me feels guilty about leaving my parents.
What would you each do in my place?
Different question: should I learn to drive this year?
